bio_text: Dylan Bryan is CMO at Casey AI, a Palo Alto-based startup building scalable AI-powered career guidance to solve the endemic under-staffing of career coaching systems. He brings a background in sales (reaching #1 at Salesforce), 5 years of hands-on coaching experience, and first-hand user research with students, giving him both a GTM and domain-level lens on the edtech/career-AI space. His GitHub work on an AI Career Advisor (AI-Pathfinder-) and research-agent repos reflects a founder-level technical curiosity beyond his marketing title.
